WITH acct AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
grand AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS grand_total FROM trans
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       d.A3 AS region,
       acct.total_amount,
       acct.trans_count,
       CAST(acct.total_amount AS REAL) / grand.grand_total AS fraction
FROM acct
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = acct.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN grand
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
